{{Quote|We do not fight out of natural aggression, but out of a deep-seated sense of self-preservation. Remove the cause of conflict, and the hostilities will cease.|Ceenda Bekkar|<ref name="GNN7" />}}
'''Ceenda Bekkar''' was a [[Trianii/Legends|Trianii]] who was the chief negotiator in discussions that attempted to end the [[CSA-Trianii War|border war]] between the Authority and the [[Trianii Colonies]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].
